name: singlet_spatial_genes_svg_detection
title: Spatially variable gene detection
description: Tests each gene for non-random expression variation across tissue coordinates and writes a score, p-value, FDR q-value and rank per gene. Use it on one spatial section with counts and obsm/spatial; the default method is sparkx. Do not use it for cell-type-specific spatial variation or for pooled multi-section data without section effects.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI, or a workspace handle, with obsm/spatial present.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without fitting any gene.

overwrite.description: Replace existing svg_* members instead of failing.

seed.description: Seed for shuffled nulls and permutations; the same seed reproduces the same p-values.

method.description: SVG test; sparkx is the provisional default, chosen for its rank in the 2025 benchmark.

layer.description: Expression layer; auto uses counts for model methods and normalized for morani and gearyc.

graph.description: Spatial graph options for morani and gearyc; other methods ignore them.

type.description: Spatial graph used by the autocorrelation statistics.

k_neighbors.description: Neighbours per unit for knn graphs; 6 suits hexagonal Visium spots.

radius.description: Distance cut-off in coordinate units for radius graphs.

library_adjust.description: How library size enters parametric models; auto matches each method's benchmark script.

alpha.description: Nominal FDR threshold used to count calls in the summary.

calibrate_null.description: Shuffled-null calibration on a gene sample; reports lambda_GC and rejection rate.

morani.description: Options for Moran's I and Geary's C (methods morani and gearyc).

n_perms.description: Permutations for permutation p-values; null uses analytic normal moments.

two_tailed.description: Two-tailed p-values for Moran's I and Geary's C.

spatialde.description: Options for the SpatialDE Gaussian-process test (method spatialde).

lengthscale_grid.description: Number of log-spaced squared-exponential lengthscales between the geometric limits.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: estimate only; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example var/svg_score. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed runs: method, n_genes_tested, n_significant_at_alpha, lambda_gc (when calibrated), null_rejection_rate and the effective parameters.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
